extension.summary: Install Roc builds from Roc Repo
extension.description: Pick a build and a tier for this device. Every build opens a preview gallery first, with the install action at the top. Installs are fingerprint-verified (SHA-256) before anything is applied, your current setup is backed up first, and the installer finishes the job itself: addons switched on, Roc OS skin set, security lockdown applied. Trakt ships installed but off — sign in once, in one sitting, after the build settles.

extension.summary: Roc OS — Eric's personal broadcast control room
extension.description: Roc OS is not a reskinned Kodi skin. It is a bespoke interface that merely runs on the Kodi engine: a living desktop of app tiles, pinned widgets, a floating glass dock with dwell flyouts, and a preview pane that shows what a thing is and does before you click. Phase 1: DESKTOP expression foundation, forked from the Arctic Zephyr donor.
extension.news: 0.4.1 — LOAD FIX (2026-10-23): the skin's resolution declaration pointed at a folder named "None" (a Phase 1 generator bug — a Python None read from the wrong XML attribute and stringified into addon.xml), so Kodi refused to load the skin on real hardware ("Skin is missing some files") even though every file was present. folder now correctly names the 1080i folder. No other changes. 0.3.0 — Phase 3 rooms: Cinema Room for Movies/TV tiles (opens as the mixed trending thumbnail grid — the grid is the tab; hero band reads the focused poster with plot, ratings and cast), War Room for Sports/WWE tiles (Mad Titan live-events board up top, WWE year scrubber 1990-now along the bottom driven by the 447-event timeline in script.rocui 0.2.0), and the Detail Stage — DialogVideoInfo re-authored Roc-style (poster, ratings with icons, cast, Play/Resume/Trailer/Trakt/More Like This rail). All Phase 1+2 behavior intact. 0.2.0 — Phase 2 wiring for script.rocui: adult tile/dock stop route through the PIN gate (PIN set by Eric on-device at first use, salted hash only); Day/Midday/Night follows the clock automatically with the dock button as manual override; per-window focus memory (service); VPN shield surface in the dock (lit = tunnel really up, dim/red = off or unknown). 0.1.0 — Phase 1 foundation: DESKTOP home (app-tile grid, Continue Watching / Live Now / clock-weather widgets, focus preview pane), floating glass dock, Wrestling + Extras dwell flyouts, Day/Midday/Night wallpaper modes, Roc Gold color schemes.

extension.summary: Roc OS helper: PIN gate, daypart clock, focus memory, VPN surface
extension.description: The engine room of Roc OS (skin.rocos). Runs as a service: keeps the Day/Midday/Night wallpaper on the clock, remembers the last focused item per window and restores it on return, publishes the real VPN tunnel state to the dock shield, and gates the adult door behind a PIN that Eric sets himself on the device (stored only as a salted PBKDF2 hash in this addon's profile data).
extension.news: 0.2.0 — Phase 3: WWE Timeline engine — the 447-event WWF/WWE PPV/PLE index (1990-2026) ships as resources/data/ppv_events.json and is served to the War Room scrubber (years rail + per-year events, date order) via a plugin source in this addon; the service also syncs the scrubber's rested year to the events pane. 0.1.0 — Phase 2: adult PIN gate (set-on-first-use, salted hash), automatic Day/Midday/Night with manual override from the dock button, per-window focus memory, VPN status surface (preparation; hardware both-states verification is an on-device phase).
